rows.section: Income tax: single rates (art. 56(1)(b)(i))
rows.basis: Chargeable income of the 2026 basis year (assessed in 2027), euro per year
rows.note: Quick method used by the tax administration: chargeable income × the band's rate, minus €1,800 (15% band), €3,400 (25% band), €9,400 (35% band). For resident individuals who do not qualify for the married or parent rates, and for each spouse who opts for a separate computation.

rows.note: Quick method used by the tax administration: chargeable income × the band's rate, minus €2,625 (15% band), €5,275 (25% band), €11,275 (35% band). Married couple maintaining one child aged 18 or under (23 or under in full-time education). Only where a spouse (for the parent rates, the individual or the spouse) is a Maltese or other EU/EEA national, or a long-term resident and the child was born in, and lives in, Malta; otherwise the standard rates above apply.

rows.section: Income tax: parent rates with one child (new for 2026)
rows.basis: Chargeable income of the 2026 basis year (assessed in 2027), euro per year
rows.note: Quick method used by the tax administration: chargeable income × the band's rate, minus €2,175 (15% band), €4,275 (25% band), €10,275 (35% band). A parent maintaining, or paying maintenance for, one child aged 18 or under (23 or under in full-time education). Only where a spouse (for the parent rates, the individual or the spouse) is a Maltese or other EU/EEA national, or a long-term resident and the child was born in, and lives in, Malta; otherwise the standard rates above apply. The statute (Act III of 2026, art. 56(1)(b)(iv)(d)) prints €10,270 as the 35% subtraction; the tax administration publishes €10,275, which follows from the bands shown.
rows.source_title: Malta Tax and Customs Administration (MTCA): Tax Rates 2026
